name: Spatial-conditioned Transolver + LayerScale
tagline: Transolver with raw 3D coordinates added as a per-head MLP bias to slice logits, plus per-block CaiT-style learnable layer scales on residual branches.

key_hyperparams.name: temperature
key_hyperparams.role: softmax temperature on slice logits, per head

diff_from_baseline: Extends the Transolver baseline by adding a coordinate-conditioned bias to slice assignment logits (so slice membership becomes spatially aware) and CaiT-style learnable per-channel residual scales (init 1e-2) on attention and MLP branches.

name: Geom-aware physics attention + SwiGLU
tagline: Transolver-style slice attention augmented with slice-centroid + std embedding, relative-position bias on slice attention, output sigmoid gate, and SwiGLU FFN.
formula: $$\mu_g = \sum_n w_{n,g}\,p_n / \sum_n w_{n,g},\quad \sigma_g = \sqrt{\sum_n w_{n,g}\,p_n^2/\sum_n w_{n,g} - \mu_g^2},\quad t_g \leftarrow t_g + \mathrm{MLP}([\mu_g; \sigma_g]),\quad A_{ij} = q_i k_j^\top + \mathrm{MLP}(\mu_i - \mu_j)$$

key_hyperparams.name: gate_proj
key_hyperparams.role: per-token sigmoid gate on attention output

key_hyperparams.name: coord_norm
key_hyperparams.value: z-score by mean and per-batch std

init_recovers: Transolver when geom_emb / rel_pos_mlp output 0 and gate output ~ 1 and SwiGLU width matches
diff_from_baseline: Extends Transolver's physics attention with weighted per-slice centroid+std geometric embeddings added to slice tokens, an MLP relative-position bias on slice-level attention, a per-token sigmoid output gate, SwiGLU FFN, and z-score-normalized coordinates.

name: Local SAGE + global slice + gate fusion
tagline: Per-block hybrid of local SAGEConv and global Physics-Attention slicing fused by a learned per-channel gate, with a coord+feature gate and global mean+max projection up front.
formula: $$z \leftarrow z + g\,\mathrm{SAGE}(\mathrm{LN}_l z) + (1-g)\,\mathrm{Attn}_{phys}(\mathrm{LN}_g z),\quad g = \sigma(W[\mathrm{SAGE}(\cdot);\mathrm{Attn}(\cdot)]),\quad z \leftarrow z(1+\sigma(W_{gf}[z; x; fx])) + W_{gp}[\overline z; \max z]$$

key_hyperparams.name: input_gate
key_hyperparams.value: sigmoid MLP on concat(z, x, fx)

key_hyperparams.name: global_proj
key_hyperparams.value: MLP on concat(mean, max) over points
key_hyperparams.role: broadcasts global stats to every point

key_hyperparams.name: edge_index_fallback
key_hyperparams.role: constructs edges if geo not provided

diff_from_baseline: Combines GraphSAGE-style local message passing with Transolver's irregular-mesh physics attention inside every block, fusing them with a per-channel sigmoid gate; adds an input coord+feature gate and global mean+max broadcast on top of the encoder.

name: Fourier coords + SAGE/slice gated hybrid
tagline: Fourier-feature coordinate encoding feeding hybrid blocks that gate per-block SAGEConv (local) against Transolver-style slice attention (global).
formula: $$\mathrm{FF}(x) = [\sin(2\pi B x), \cos(2\pi B x)] W_{\mathrm{FF}}\;,\quad z_{\mathrm{fused}} = g\,\mathrm{SAGE}(z) + (1-g)\,\mathrm{Attn}_{phys}(z),\quad g = \sigma(W[\,z_{loc};\,z_{glob}\,])$$

key_hyperparams.name: num_freqs
key_hyperparams.role: Gaussian frequencies for sin/cos coord encoding

key_hyperparams.name: CONFIG_OVERRIDES_effective
key_hyperparams.role: second redefinition wipes the n_hidden=192/slice_num=32 override

diff_from_baseline: Encodes coordinates with Fourier features before the encoder, then in each block fuses SAGEConv local message passing with Transolver-style slice attention via a learned scalar gate. (Note: CONFIG_OVERRIDES is overwritten by an empty dict at the bottom of the file, so n_hidden and slice_num fall back to defaults.)

name: Two SAGEConvs then physics attention
tagline: Two stacked SAGEConv+BatchNorm+GELU layers for local mesh structure, followed by one Transolver Physics-Attention block (LN, attn, LN, MLP) before the decoder.
diff_from_baseline: Stacks two SAGEConv graph layers (with BatchNorm + GELU) before a single Transolver-style physics-attention block; combines the GraphSAGE and Transolver baselines into one model with a fixed depth of 2+1.
